body: Since these are iOS specific properties, it's better to move definitions and handling from Apple Embedded base class to the [iOS export plugin](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/ios/export/export_plugin.cpp).

For the reference, properties are documented as `Unavailable in visionOS`, so the change is correct.

https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/information-property-list/uirequireddevicecapabilities?language=objc

> Since these are iOS specific properties, it's better to move definitions and handling from Apple Embedded base class to the [iOS export plugin](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/ios/export/export_plugin.cpp).

Yes, that makes more sense. I pushed down the two capabilities into the iOS plugin.
